title: Post Exposure Recovery Serum
body_html:
DERMFIX⁺ Post Exposure Recovery Serum

Recover. Soothe. Hydrate. Strengthen.

Your skin faces daily exposure to UV radiation, pollution, heat, dust and environmental stressors. DERMFIX⁺ Post Exposure Recovery Serum is designed as a post-exposure skincare step to support skin recovery and maintain a healthy skin barrier.

Powered by 2% Ectoin, with a supportive blend of Niacinamide, Tranexamic Acid and Centella Extract, the lightweight serum helps provide hydration, comfort and barrier-focused care after everyday environmental exposure.

Why DERMFIX⁺?

  • 2% Ectoin Technology — supports skin resilience against environmental stress.
  • Barrier-focused care — helps maintain a healthy skin barrier.
  • Soothing care — designed to calm the feeling of stressed or uncomfortable skin.
  • Hydration — helps replenish and maintain skin moisture.
  • Lightweight texture — absorbs easily without a heavy feel.
  • Fragrance-free formula — made without added fragrance.

Key Actives

Ectoin 2%
A naturally derived extremolyte used in skincare for its skin-protective and hydration-supporting properties.

Niacinamide
Helps support the skin barrier and overall skin appearance.

Tranexamic Acid
Included as part of the formula to support a more even-looking complexion.

Centella Extract
Known for its soothing and skin-conditioning properties.

How to Use

After cleansing, apply 2–3 drops evenly over the face and neck. Gently pat until absorbed.

Recommended: Use as part of your post-exposure skincare routine, especially after a day outdoors or following environmental exposure.

For daytime use, follow with sunscreen.

Who Is It For?

Designed for people looking for a simple post-exposure recovery step in their daily skincare routine.

30 mL | Fragrance Free | External Use Only

Your Daily Recovery Step

Exposure happens. Recovery matters.
Make DERMFIX⁺ part of your skin routine.
